noProfiles: The server's profiles could not be read:
noRuntimes: The machines could not be read: {why}
trajectoriesHint: Every helper sent from it, every step since it took the ticket: what it heard, every tool it used (click a row for the input and output), what it said. Steps are kept 30 days after it leaves; the helper itself stays listed.
fine: The configuration is fine: it can be sent work.
looksHint: Only looks: the same runtime can be different animals.
name: Name
nameTip: The manager and the captions call it this, and you can name it when you speak.
nameTaken: An agent of this name already exists
dutyTip: A sentence. The manager reads it when picking someone.
roleHint: Such as: writes endpoints, changes the server, runs the Go tests
tagsTip: When your words have these, the manager on Auto sends it first. Enter adds one.
enabledHint: Disabled, the manager does not send it, and refuses when it is named.
workdirTip: A folder under the work folder (VIBEVALLEY_WORK_ROOT). Used when the manager sends work without naming a project; when empty, the project must be named.
worktree: A git worktree for each helper
worktreeHint: Each helper changes its own branch, so helpers do not overwrite each other; completing merges it into the project. Off, it changes the project directly, with no branch to merge.
envHint: On top of the runtime's own environment variables.
machineTip: Changing the machine clears the model and the effort; the looks (animal and outfit) stay.
noModels: This runtime cannot list its models right now.
noSteer: Cannot be interrupted while it works: words queue after the round
inProcess: · Runs inside the server process (Node SDK)
ownProcess: · Runs as its own command-line process

append.label: Append to the system prompt
append.detail: Keeps the runtime's own way of working and adds the persona after it. Usually this one.

replace.label: Replace the system prompt
replace.detail: Replaces the runtime's own system prompt whole. Only when you know what you are doing.

prompt.label: Put at the top of each ticket
prompt.detail: Adds the persona before each ticket. Every runtime can do it, but a long conversation dilutes it.

personaTip: Who it is, how it works, what it does not do. It goes to the runtime the way picked below.
personaHint: You are a careful backend engineer. Understand the code before you change it…
personaMode: How it goes to the runtime
libraryTip: The skills picked go to the helper with the persona, a section each.
ownSkillsTip: Reported by the runtime: already usable on this machine, no need to tick them here.
mcpHint: Given to the runtime when a session opens (oar's SessionOptions.mcpServers).
disallowedHint: This agent cannot use these tools. Click a tool the runtime reports below to add it.
ownMcpTip: Reported by the runtime, together with those added above.
unreported: This runtime does not report this.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Each template is a recipe for an agent: its role, duty, persona, the machine it is written for and its look. Installing one adds a profile, and one template can be installed many times; change what is installed as you like, and when the template has a new version the profile says so.
templates.openLine: Recipes for managers and helpers, to pick from
templates.folderHint: The path of a template folder on this machine (with agent.json in it)
templates.added: The template "{name}" is added, not installed yet
templates.runsOn: Written for {runtime}, which this machine has
templates.notHere: Written for {runtime}, which this machine lacks: once installed, pick another machine in the profile
templates.none: No helpers yet: install some from a template, or make one yourself.
templates.updateHint: The template's new version replaces the duty, tags, persona and how it is given; the name, look, machine, model and environment stay.

orchestrator.intro: A manager stays, leads and does no work itself: it hears what you want done, sends helpers to do it, watches progress and passes on results. It runs on VibeValley's own agent, with its own direct messages, memory and trajectory; hand it a channel to look after, and what you say there it answers.
orchestrator.nameTip: Its name in the chat; others call it with @ and its profile id.
orchestrator.modelTip: A DeepSeek model; empty is the default one.
orchestrator.dutyTip: One sentence: what it looks after.
orchestrator.personaTip: Who it is, how it talks, what it looks after; it follows the manager's prompt.
orchestrator.personaHint: You look after the clock-in project; read the tests before sending work…

list.title: Profiles
list.intro: Each profile is an agent. Managers stay, lead and do no work themselves, and there may be several; helpers are runtimes set up: which runtime and model, what persona and skills, and which little animal they are on the farm. When a manager sends work, it sends a helper.
list.orchestratorLine: Not a helper: sends work, watches progress, passes on results.
list.tallyHint: How many times helpers sent from this profile got work merged into main

noEffort: This model has no effort levels.
